name: application-announcement-banner
title: Announcement Banner
description: Full-width, dismissible top-of-page bar for product news, promotions, or maintenance notices, with info/success/warning severity variants and an optional CTA button.
useWhen: Announcing a product update, new feature, or promotion to every visitor across the whole app.
Communicating scheduled maintenance or a service-wide notice that isn't tied to one specific action.
The message is relevant to the whole page/session rather than a single form field or action result.
avoidWhen: The message is a direct result of a user action — use a toast instead.
The message is scoped to one section or form, not the whole page — use an inline alert instead.
You need to show several banners at once — a single top banner is meant to be the one most important message.
responsiveBehavior: The bar spans full width with centered, wrapping content; on narrow viewports the message, CTA, and dismiss button wrap onto their own lines while staying centered.
accessibility: Wrapped in role='region' with aria-label='Announcement' so assistive tech can locate and skip it.
The dismiss button has an explicit aria-label since it only contains an icon.
Severity is conveyed via background color and message text together, not color alone — no icon-only meaning.

variants.title: Announcement banner
variants.description: Info-toned full-width banner with a CTA button and dismiss control on a light surface.
accessibility: Focus rings on the CTA and dismiss button use ring-offset colors that stay visible against the colored banner background.

variants.title: Announcement banner (Dark)
variants.description: Info-toned full-width banner with a CTA button and dismiss control, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Text and CTA colors must meet WCAG AA contrast against each severity's dark background tint.
